confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and meal anchors are based on web searches of aggregated cost-of-living indexes (Numbeo-style crowd-sourced data, Expatistan, and others). Those sources vary widely, so I picked values in the middle of the reported ranges. The cocktail anchor comes from a Yucatán Today bar-tour guide, which lists house cocktails at about 105-150 MXN. I found no wine-by-the-glass price for Mérida, so I set that anchor relative to beer and cocktail prices. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for or inspect any listings. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation, which was the latest I found in search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mérida is a mid-priced Mexican tourist city. Its restaurant prices are somewhat above the national average, and it is cheaper than Mexico City's upscale areas and Riviera Maya resorts.
